notes: Official Hanwha Vision datasheet (X series, Ver. 202409, 6 pages) confirms: 5MP 1/1.8" CMOS vandal-resistant PTRZ dome, motorized 3.6-9.4mm/2.6x zoom lens, IP66/IP67/IK10+/NEMA4X, aluminum housing, Ø180x125mm, 1.75kg. Desktop/wall/pendant mount accessory camera — not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Two internal Micro SD/SDHC/SDXC slots (max 256GB each, 512GB total) exist but were omitted from ports since they are storage slots, not signal/power connectors. Confidence set to medium because the Ethernet (RJ-45, 10/100BASE-T -> eth-100m) and USB Micro-B "Video Out" connectors are explicitly confirmed, but the datasheet does not name the actual physical connector hardware for the 12VDC/24VAC power input, alarm I/O, or audio I/O (it only describes them functionally) — these four ports were approximated as "euroblock" (screw-terminal block), which is standard for this camera family's pigtail cable but not verified against an installation manual or photo. No HDMI/SDI/display outputs exist on this device — "Video Out" is a maintenance/setup port only, not a program video output.

ports.name: Ethernet (PoE)
ports.note: RJ-45 10/100BASE-T network port; also delivers power via PoE (IEEE 802.3af, Class 3).

ports.name: Power In (12VDC/24VAC)
ports.note: Datasheet lists Input Voltage as PoE(IEEE802.3af Class3), 24VAC, 12VDC. Physical hardware for the 12VDC/24VAC input is not explicitly named in the datasheet; Hanwha X-series domes use a bare-wire screw-terminal block on the internal pigtail, approximated here as 'euroblock'.

ports.name: Alarm In
ports.note: Alarm Interface: Input 1ea. Screw-terminal contact on pigtail; exact connector part not named in datasheet (inferred).

ports.name: Alarm Out
ports.note: Alarm Interface: Output 1ea (relay). Screw-terminal contact on pigtail; exact connector part not named in datasheet (inferred).

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: Selectable mic in / line in. Physical connector type not stated in datasheet; approximated as terminal block, consistent with this camera's pigtail-cable design (inferred).

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Line out. Physical connector type not stated in datasheet; approximated as terminal block (inferred).

ports.name: Video Out
ports.note: Micro USB Type-B port used for local video monitoring during installation/setup (per datasheet 'Video Out: USB: Micro USB Type B'). No USB data-rate stated, so no grade set.
